final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.avg_cost_ratio, i.avg_quantity - o.avg_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL AND i.avg_quantity > o.avg_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10
